Title: Create a new item with measuring parameters
Preconditions: No existing items with the same name and parameters
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData. 2. Note the returned item ID from the response.

Test Data: {"name": "Shirt", "parameters": [{"name": "Chest", "unit": "cm"}, {"name": "Length", "unit": "cm"}]}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Shirt", "parameters": [{"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Chest", "unit": "cm"}, {"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Length", "unit": "cm"}]}

Title: Update an existing item's name and measuring parameters
Preconditions: An item with ID 1 exists in the system
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/items/1 with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response contains the updated item details.

Test Data: {"name": "Formal Shirt", "parameters": [{"name": "Chest", "unit": "inch"}, {"name": "Sleeve Length", "unit": "inch"}]}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"id": 1, "name": "Formal Shirt", "parameters": [{"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Chest", "unit": "inch"}, {"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Sleeve Length", "unit": "inch"}]}

Title: Retrieve all items with their measuring parameters
Preconditions: At least one item exists in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items. 2. Verify the response contains the list of items with their parameters.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON array containing at least one item: [{"id": <non-null number>, "name": <item name>, "parameters": [{"id": <non-null number>, "name": <parameter name>, "unit": <unit>}]}]

Title: Associate measuring parameters with an item during creation
Preconditions: No existing item with the same name
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response contains the item with associated parameters.

Test Data: {"name": "Pant", "parameters": [{"name": "Waist", "unit": "cm"}, {"name": "Inseam", "unit": "cm"}]}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Pant", "parameters": [{"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Waist", "unit": "cm"}, {"id": <non-null number>, "name": "Inseam", "unit": "cm"}]}
